label: PoE video doorbell
description: Flush-mount professional video doorbell that runs entirely on Power over Ethernet: one 10/100 Ethernet cable carries both power and video. 1080p HD video with two-way talk.
notes: PoE class 802.3af, 12.95 W - the rare consumer IoT endpoint that is genuinely PoE powered, wired only for IP (its 802.11 radio is not used for the network path). No mains wiring needed, which is why it is the interesting exception in this category.
